sameDayRetelling: Bryn Ash, my Guarded fighter, finally broke the Warlord that had driven him out twice, then went on to slay the Bloat Mother and Lich and was sent home by the Foundry Master at D23. I slotted mirror read, and on the very next run he killed the Foundry Master and banked over $13,000. Hours later his heirs kept dying to the Mirror King on D33, and even after I reordered my priorities so retreat sat above attack boss, Iris Ash still fell there with $3680 lost.

humanProbes.clarity: Did you ever not know what to do? Yes: forecast said 'D8 try: attack boss' but the tactic showed 'boss focus ⊘ slay Warlord', and twice the REPORT gem did nothing until I reloaded.
humanProbes.decisions: I swapped Steady for Guarded after 'better 5/8' and slotted mirror read after the Foundry Master sent Bryn home; I would make both again.
humanProbes.mastery: An hour ago I didn't know 'COUNTER: REFLECT READ'; now I read the enemy guide ('mirror king · counter cadence') before choosing tactics.
humanProbes.tension: I sweated at 'Carried $3949 · Secured $0' on D33 with the King ahead; the game noticed with 'RETURNED $2418 · keeps 60%'.
humanProbes.feel: The 'FOUNDRY MASTER DOWN' / 'WARLORD BREAKS' banners felt good; a minute of 'goblin warlord · calls goblins' with hp ticking 26→16 did not (audio unassessed).
humanProbes.surprise: 'Grusk the jackal, gone wild' and 'Cut the captive down. No one weeps.' surprised me; the King mirroring blows changed my rule order.
humanProbes.expression: A bloodline of Guarded fighters with mirror read + quiet steps beside a rogue line on iron gut and kite archers.
humanProbes.story: '♟2 the brave rogue · took the Warlord · found ♟1's bones · fell to gas · left bones on D13.'
humanProbes.pacing: Play dragged at the D8 warlord loop and the 20m 'Departs' rests; admin dragged in fiddly sheets; I wanted one more when 'floor 24 75%' appeared.
humanProbes.failure: Hale lost because 'attack boss over 45%' fired at 48/50 then 25/50 vs the King; the screen offered 'hp < 70% → return · survives 11/12 · was 3/12' — partly my fault for not having that rule.
humanProbes.social: No one; heirs are names in a chronicle.
humanProbes.autonomy: I founded a second bloodline for $250 and made Una a rogue though nothing asked me to.
humanProbes.progression: Within run: D5 to D33; persistent: 'sword +5 · mail +2', legacy ranks; automation: porter, scout ('sends him each rest'), apprentice ('−$24500' forge on its own).
humanProbes.aesthetic: A torn red banner with the archer's portrait over a broken shield, 'YOU DIED' wax seal; I'd sit in the lamplit town at night.
humanProbes.return: After 4h: 'While away 9 RUNS D33 · purse +$313 · forge −$24500' and new tactics; I re-slotted personalities. After 8h: '8/12 DEATHS · $18399 lost' — I'd rather have stayed for that one.
humanProbes.attribution: 'Mirror read' was my pick and the Foundry Master fell next run; Iris's King death after I reordered retreat above attack boss was mine too — 'I' put return at 25% too low.
